description: This file defines a PHP trait 'LeavePermissionTrait' used within the OrangeHRM leave plugin. It provides an access control method 'checkLeaveAccessible' that verifies whether the current user has permission to access a leave record. The trait uses user role management functionalities and enforces that it is used in classes implementing 'Endpoint'.

methods.name: checkLeaveAccessible
methods.description: Verifies if the current user has permission to access a specific leave record; throws exception if not accessible.
